newsitem.title: UK: UK meals lower, trade confined to short covering.
newsitem.headline: UK meals lower, trade confined to short covering.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were mostly lower on Wednesday but trade was confined mainly to pre-holiday short covering.
"People are just buying odd loads here and there to top supplies ahead of the holiday," said a trader.
Palmkernel pellets traded at 74 stg a tonne for spot ex-store Newport while Cragill rapemeal ex-mill Liverpool fetched 126 stg for December.
Asking prices for high protein soymeal were around two to three stg down ex-mill and store.
